title: SlopFactory export sidecar
description: A `.slopfactory.json` sidecar written next to an exported media file (see docs/developer/architecture.md, "External export sidecars"). Unsigned documentation, may be modified after export, and is never proof of provider authorship, media authenticity, or an unaltered SlopFactory record. A structural or semantic change to this document always increments sidecarSchemaVersion; published fields are never repurposed.

$schema.description: Stable schema identity, matching this document's own $id.

sidecarSchemaVersion.description: Integer sidecar format version. Always present; bumped on any structural or semantic change.

mediaType.description: The exported file's detected media (MIME) type.

byteSize.description: The exported file's size in bytes.

contentHash.description: SHA-256 content hash of the exported file, lowercase hex.

importedAt.description: When the file was imported or generated into the library.

modifiedAt.description: When the file's library record was last modified.

origin.description: How the file entered the library.

displayName.description: Present only when the Include Filenames disclosure opt-in was selected.

originalFileName.description: Present only when the Include Filenames disclosure opt-in was selected.

fileId.description: The library's internal file identifier. Present only when the Include Internal Identifiers opt-in was selected. Never a provider request ID — this app never persists one.

generationRecordId.description: The library's internal generation-record identifier. Present only when Include Internal Identifiers was selected and the file has a known originating generation.

modelId.description: The library's internal model identifier. Present only when Include Internal Identifiers was selected and the file has a known originating generation with an active model.

providerType.description: The originating generation's provider (a label snapshot, not a live provider identity). Present only when the file has a known originating generation.

modelLabel.description: The originating generation's model label snapshot. Present only when the file has a known originating generation.

generationProvenanceState.description: How reliable/live the attached generation provenance is: current (the terminal record as-is), nonterminal-snapshot (the generation had not reached a terminal status), history-recycled (the generation record has since been recycled), or unavailable (no originating generation could be found).

statusObservedAt.description: When the originating generation's attached status was last observed. Present only when the file has a known originating generation with a completion timestamp.

prompt.description: The originating generation's prompt text. Present only when the Include Prompt disclosure opt-in was selected.

systemInstructions.description: The originating generation's system instructions, if any. Present only when Include Prompt was selected.

actualCost.description: Provider-reported actual cost for the generation. Present only when the Include Usage and Cost opt-in was selected and a cost was reported.

actualCostCurrency.description: Currency for actualCost. Present only alongside actualCost.

promptTokens.description: Present only when Include Usage and Cost was selected and reported by the provider.

completionTokens.description: Present only when Include Usage and Cost was selected and reported by the provider.

generationSettings.description: Present only when the Include Advanced Settings opt-in was selected.

advancedJson.description: Redacted advanced-settings JSON (credential-shaped values already stripped).

sensitiveMetadataUnavailable.description: Present only when the Include Sensitive Metadata opt-in was selected; this app has no metadata-entries feature yet, so nothing is ever attached under that opt-in.

safetyMetadataUnavailable.description: Present only when the Include Provider Safety Metadata opt-in was selected; no persisted, content-hash-bound safety classification exists in this app yet, so nothing is ever attached under that opt-in.
